title: Hoshino Ichika — Happy Birthday!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: The next day
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I'm all set to go, so I think I'll get started.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: There she is! Ichika!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Minori, Kiritani!
Wait, Saki and... You all came?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. We were hoping to be able to catch your street performance, Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Same. We're looking forward to seeing what you have in store for us.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Haha. I'm starting to get a bit nervous...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm sure you'll do fine, Ichika. Just sing the way you always do.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Hm? I could've sworn that I saw Kohane just now... Or am I imagining things?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Alright, I'll get started.

rows.Speaker: Minori & Saki
rows.Line: Woohoo!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Um, so... How was it?
Did you all enjoy it?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yes, it was very enjoyable.
I even got to hear you play some originals that you said you and your band made.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, I was so moved by those songs!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Me too! Even though we wrote it ourselves, I couldn't believe how different it felt when it was just one person playing it!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, I felt the same way.
It was like my heart was being gently wrapped in loving warmth...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. I especially liked how you made it easy for your audience to really soak in the music.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
I'm so happy to hear that!
I can't even begin to thank you all for...
Not so fast!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That voice...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?! What are all of you guys doing here?
Don't forget us.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Shizuku?! Momoi?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. We received word from Minori and Kohane that you'd be doing a street performance today.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We were told by Saki and felt that we had no choice but to rush over!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Sorry we couldn't celebrate with you yesterday, Ichika. We had to put on a show and couldn't make it to school because of it...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But we figured that we could celebrate with you today... Which is why we're all here...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, um... Happy birthday, Hoshino.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Ichika!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup yup! We wish you a happy and wonderhoy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
We'd like to as well.
Happy birthday, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you...! Thank you all so much!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank goodness our surprise went okay.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. Also, thanks for letting me know...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. It was my pleasure!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: If only Kanade and Ena were able to join us. Then everything would've been perfect...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? Did you invite them too?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, but Ena said that she had a prior commitment today.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: As for Kanade, I'm not sure if she's even seen my message...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm guessing she's hard at work composing more music.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Right. She may be taking a nap at this time too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, right...! But!
I'm sure she would've come if she saw my message!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I appreciate what you did, Minori...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
You as well, Kohane, Saki.
Thank you for going through all this trouble for me. I really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Saki & Kohane
rows.Line: You're very welcome!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I really feel like singing now♪
Oh, let's all sing together!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hold on, Emu. If we do that, we'll cause a panic which will surely lead to a mob of people trampling over one another to listen to our beautiful voices, no?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Where does that confidence of yours come from exactly...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh no! Ichika, I should've recorded your street performance on my phone for Kanade and Ena!!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I took a video as per Airi's request.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, Ena seemed a little bummed out after inviting her and not being able to join us. I hope it'll help cheer her up.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
That's so sweet of you, Airi.
Let's make sure to send it to Ena and the others later.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Kohane, thanks for helping out with Saki's surprise.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, that's okay. I had a lot of fun since I also wanted to do something to celebrate Ichika's birthday!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Also, I'm glad that the rain stopped.
The weather forecast said that it'd be raining the entire day.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That must mean the growling weather charms we made based on Shibao must've worked.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (They all gathered here just for me...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Even though the world looked so dull and gray while feeling so lonely every day just after entering high school...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But now...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, everyone, over there!
Look at the sky!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? The sky?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wow, it's a rainbow!
It's kinda far away but you can still see it!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, it's beautiful...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Just so beautiful...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Ichika.
I saw that video of your street performance. You were so amazing.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Let me know when you plan on doing another one. I really want to see you perform live. Also, exercising. Kanade in particular seems to need a workout partner to get motivated.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Y-You didn't have to say it out loud...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Um... Happy birthday, Hoshino.
I apologize for not seeing that message sooner...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But Ena showed me that video of your performance. I really enjoyed listening to your original music, so I'll make an effort to see you live next time.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Hoshino.
Kanade and Ena surprised me by saying that today's your special day. I wish I'd known sooner. It would've been so nice to celebrate...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But we can do that with Kanade and Ena next time! For now, have a wonderful birthday!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Once more, Ichika, happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. I know it's your special day, but I think we all had lots and lots of fun☆

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. I really enjoyed getting a hold of Nene and the others in secret and leading them around while we hid during your performance, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And you put on an excellent performance. Your singing voice was so good that even I felt somewhat envious at times!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I've known you since you were little, and you used to be a bit rash or hasty back then... To think that you'd blossom like this...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Why are you talking like you're some distant uncle of hers? Also, give me a chance to talk. Gimme that!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So... I'm glad to see that you've been practicing so much. You even fixed the part that we talked about the other day...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And you're really making it clear how you feel through your singing. I hope you keep this up, and... I hope we get to practice together again soon.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, I'd like to join you guys for that. It's never not fun when we practice together and I always end up learning so much.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, pushing each other to reach higher ground. Such is the beauty of youth. Ichika, I hope you, Saki and the others all have fun!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. We got to spend two days celebrating your birthday! I've gotta think we, the party planners, also had a lot of fun!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I agree. You seemed to really enjoy everything, Hoshino, so I'm glad we did this.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Ichika, you're always looking out for Shii's best interests, so I hope you two keep being the wonderful friends you are.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I mean, as long as the four of them are together, I'm sure they'll be able to overcome whatever obstacles that come their way.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I agree.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: See you at school, Hoshino!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Ichika.
I don't know if you remember, but the time you said, “You're not a burden,” made me so happy...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We have a long road ahead of us when it comes to making our dream a reality, but you have my complete trust. I'm looking forward to seeing what the future has in store for us...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Ichika.
Since we were little, I've always admired how you can focus on doing one thing after you've set your mind to it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Which is why I want to be just like you and keep doing whatever I can for our band. Hehe. I'll be right there with you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi! Happy, happy, happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
So... U-Uh oh...
I forgot what I was going to say! I had so many things prepared!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I was gonna say something about school, about studying, about club stuff and work stuff, about our band! Everything!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I have to thank you for all of the above! I'm standing here today because you've always been there for me!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. Let's be besties forever and ever until we're both old and gray♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So many people joined me to celebrate my birthday.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I don't want your kindness to go to waste, so I'll have to do my best to move forward and make real progress.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Because I believe that showing you how I grow along the way is the best way to show my appreciation for you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I have to do everything I can to make Leo/need a much better band, and I personally have to figure out a way to become a better songwriter.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Especially since I want to give Miku a good song to sing someday...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Anyway, I'll see you later.
Thank you so much for today!
